{
  "version": "1.70.73",
  "updatedAt": "2026-08-31",
  "standards": [
    {
      "id": "ui.base-components.first",
      "title": "Base Components First",
      "value": "whenever building UI, use the shared primitives demonstrated on the Base Components page (/studio/base-components, pageKey base-components, catalog src/features/base-components/); do not invent custom base controls, raw HTML form inputs/checkboxes/textareas, or ad-hoc HeroUI markup when a catalogued section exists; match the living sample for that section (component, props, sizes, intents, chrome); Base Components is the visual source of truth — remaining projectStandards entries and topic shards are implementation detail for those primitives",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all new UI work",
        "forms",
        "dialogs",
        "toolbars",
        "grids",
        "buttons",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.heroui.no-custom-base-if-equivalent",
      "title": "No Custom Base Controls When Catalog Equivalent Exists",
      "value": "do not create custom base UI elements when Base Components already catalogs an equivalent section or shared wrapper",
      "appliesTo": [
        "input",
        "select",
        "checkbox",
        "textarea",
        "button",
        "modal",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.component.default-size",
      "title": "Default Form Control Size",
      "value": "match Base Components → Form fields group: sm is the default for form field controls (UiInput, UiSelect, UiTextarea, UiAutocomplete, UiCombobox, UiCheckbox, SemVerInput, UrlSegmentSlugInput, DesignerMaskInputField, DesignerDatePickerField); omit size or pass size=\"sm\"; prefer sm and md for routine forms, settings, modals, and toolbars — xs and lg are also supported (see src/shared/ui/heroFieldSize.ts) when a surface needs tighter or larger controls; size is not hard-limited to sm/md; use UiCombobox (HeroUI ComboBox) for typeable filterable pickers — not button-style UiAutocomplete; UiCombobox menuTrigger is focus (default, open list on focus), input (suggestions only after typing), or manual",
      "appliesTo": [
        "UiInput",
        "UiSelect",
        "UiTextarea",
        "UiAutocomplete",
        "UiCombobox",
        "UiCheckbox",
        "form fields",
        "settings forms",
        "create/edit modals",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.semantic-color-restraint",
      "title": "Semantic Color — Subtle and Small-Area",
      "value": "use gentle, concept-matched color to aid scanning — not decoration; prefer color on text, icons, badges, pills, and other small objects; keep large surfaces white/neutral slate (page shell #F8FAFC, cards #FFFFFF, sidebar/header un-tinted, modal body, grid host); never paint chrome from the operator accent; status badges use fixed emerald #10B981 / amber #F59E0B / red #EF4444 and must not follow Cranberry or Gray; reuse existing semantic maps (buttonSemantics.ts, ICON_ACTION_*_CLASS, APP_SURFACE_BOX_TONE_CLASS, grid action colors) — no ad-hoc palette entries; one or two accent hues per view is enough",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all pages",
        "forms",
        "panels",
        "labels",
        "badges",
        "icons",
        "status text"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.accent-scope",
      "title": "Accent Color — 10% Rule, Neutral Chrome",
      "value": "operator accent applies only to primary/create buttons, active sidebar item indicator plus active text/icon, focused input borders, progress bars, and the brand mark; sidebar, header, and page body stay Tailwind slate (#FFFFFF cards, #F8FAFC page, #111827 dark) when generated from the accent picker and must not receive tinted primary fills from that generator; Theme Designer tokens are per logged-in user (theme_presets) with a public catalog default; login screen stays the fixed default accent; dashboard page fill uses bg-surface-shell; secondary icons use a #F1F5F9 well with accent on the glyph only; body text is #334155 or #0F172A (WCAG AA on Light/Soft/Core/Rich/Deep); status Ready/Active/Connected/Errors stay emerald/amber/red regardless of Cranberry or Gray; generated by accentColorUtils.ts + colorTokens.ts — see docs/standards/ui-design-system.md §1",
      "appliesTo": [
        "theme generation",
        "admin shell",
        "sidebar",
        "header",
        "AccentColorPicker",
        "dashboard",
        "status badges",
        "AppButton",
        "Theme Designer"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.color-it",
      "title": "Operator Cue — Color It (رنگیش کن)",
      "value": "when an operator says “color it” / «رنگیش کن», add concept-matched accents only on small-area backgrounds, borders, fonts/labels, and icons — never large body fills; choose hue from content meaning first (identity indigo/violet, technical cyan, relation emerald/lime, caution/PK amber, danger rose, success emerald), then reuse FormSection / APP_SURFACE_BOX_TONE_CLASS / buttonSemantics maps; do not color every element — restraint beats rainbow; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Color it",
      "appliesTo": [
        "dialogs",
        "forms",
        "panels",
        "property editors",
        "summary sidebars",
        "section labels",
        "badges",
        "icons"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.icon-label-gap",
      "title": "Icon Beside Title or Label Must Have a Gap",
      "value": "when a Lucide icon sits beside a title or label, wrap them in inline-flex items-center with a gap — gap-1.5 compact (AppButton, option-card titles, chips, ICON_LABEL_ROW_CLASS) or gap-2 page/section headers (PAGE_HEADER_ICON_TITLE_CLUSTER_CLASS); never adjacent siblings with no gap; constrain the SVG (h-3.5/h-4 + overflow-hidden, PAGE_HEADER_ICON_SLOT_CLASS on page headers) so the glyph cannot overflow into the letters; nav rails keep gap-3 (WORKSPACE_SECTION_NAV_LINK_BASE_CLASS); see docs/standards/ui-design-system.md §6 Icons and ui-toolbar.md §Page header",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page headers",
        "PageHeaderToolbar",
        "section titles",
        "labeled buttons",
        "option cards",
        "dialog titles",
        "floating panels"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.page-guide.hints",
      "title": "Page Guide Title And Hint On Explainable Controls",
      "value": "the studio page guide walks [data-page-guide] stops that have both title and hint; page content (toolbars, create, paging, dialogs, FormField/FormSection, designer, Data Studio) is first and shell header/sidebar chrome is last; skip Home nav and studio logo chrome; FormField hint, FormSection hint or description, FieldHintTooltip, Settings labelInfo, and PageHeaderToolbar description are auto-stops; AppButton intent=create, AppSplitButton intent=create, ToolbarSearchInput, ToolbarRefreshButton, ToolbarFilterRadioGroup, ToolbarFilterSelect, ToolbarFilterCheckbox, ToolbarFilterMatchLogicBadge, GridPagingFooter, and AppSearchBox are local page stops; generators and designer auto-CRUD must emit a plain-language hint on every generated field; sidebar trigger uses the Bot icon; click the companion to cycle body shapes; a CircleHelp control beside close in the bubble closes the tour and opens AppEndO chat and the companion leaves while the panel is open; the same CircleHelp beside close on the chat panel closes chat and restores the tour companion; drag it and release to hop it back under the bubble; the active hotspot stays visible and the bubble/companion do not cover it; bubble play/previous/next/done/close are ghost icon-only ICON_ACTION buttons with no visible labels; play shows a cyan circular countdown for the 8-second autoplay interval; hotspot dots swallow pointer events so the control underneath does not activate; do not invent filler hints on every existing field or unlabeled nav item; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Page guide",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page guide",
        "FormField",
        "FormSection",
        "PageHeaderToolbar",
        "Component Designer",
        "auto CRUD",
        "generated UI"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.choice.option-cards",
      "title": "Exclusive Option Cards (No Radio Dots)",
      "value": "when each exclusive option has a title plus description (mode/policy/encryption pickers, not a short label list), render UiOptionCardGroup (src/shared/ui/UiOptionCardGroup.tsx): one bordered button/box per option (two options → columns=2, three → columns=3, long stacks → columns=1, short name chips that hug their label → columns=auto) with no visible radio — not UiRadioChoiceList, not HeroUI Radio, do not revive a radio-card wrapper; host role=radiogroup, each button role=radio aria-checked; selected state is accent border+light fill; optional per-option tone (AppSurfaceBoxTone) tints border/icon/title at rest and the selected wash — group accentClassName is the fallback; descriptions wrap (whitespace-pre-line); optional Lucide icon sits in the title row (inline-flex items-center gap-1.5, h-3.5 w-3.5 compact / h-4 w-4 default) never a separate chip; field label stays above the grid; living sample Base Components → Choice; product wrapper SmtpEncryptionField; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Exclusive option cards",
      "appliesTo": [
        "option cards",
        "UiOptionCardGroup",
        "encryption",
        "mode pickers",
        "policy pickers",
        "SmtpEncryptionField",
        "settings forms",
        "wizards",
        "form fields",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.ai-chat-panel",
      "title": "Standard AI Chat Panel",
      "value": "all in-app AI chats (SQL Console, Image Editor, SSH Hub, File Hub, Server Functions editor, AppEndO header agent) mount UiContextChatPanel from Base Components → AI Chat Panel; hosts decide docking (beside a console vs inside a host window) — placement is not a catalog option; hosts send context and apply actions through onSend or onSubmitPrompt plus slots (headerSlot, bodySlot, prompt toolbars); pass codeDiffBaseline so ChatCodeBlock shows a changed-line-only diff for full replacements and collapses after 5 displayed lines (AppButton intent=utility expand/collapse); agency is host-settable via agencyModes/agencyMode (ask = chat only, read-only = auto-run read commands, agentic = run every action) with agencyPickerVariant buttons or dropdown; omit agencyModes when the host owns a different mode control; session history stays in the host window, not in this chrome; do not rebuild message-list/prompt/model/send chrome per surface; living sample /studio/base-components/ai-chat-panel; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §AI chat panel",
      "appliesTo": [
        "UiContextChatPanel",
        "ChatCodeBlock",
        "SqlConsoleAiPanel",
        "ImageEditorAiPanel",
        "SshHubAiPanel",
        "FileHubAiPanel",
        "ServerFunctionAiPanel",
        "AppEndooPanel",
        "AI chat",
        "Base Components",
        "Server Functions"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.dialog.primary-header",
      "title": "Dialog Primary Header",
      "value": "PrimaryHeader uses DIALOG_PRIMARY_HEADER_CLASS (h-10 fixed); title plus optional headerExtra icon-only controls (AppButton size=icon-sm) before Close; Close is optional via showCloseButton (hide it when the operator must decide in the footer) and is always rightmost via AppButton closeIcon when shown; no labeled buttons in primary header",
      "appliesTo": [
        "dialog headers",
        "modal headers",
        "DialogPrimaryHeader"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.dialog.footers",
      "title": "Dialog Footers",
      "value": "multiple footers allowed; footer surface uses DIALOG_FOOTER_SURFACE_BG_CLASS (bg-slate-100/90) via surface chrome footer tokens or DIALOG_ACTION_FOOTER_CLASS / DIALOG_AUXILIARY_FOOTER_CLASS / CREATE_EDIT_MODAL_FOOTER_CLASS / STEP_WIZARD_FOOTER_CLASS / GRID_PAGING_FOOTER_CLASS; ActionFooter (DIALOG_ACTION_FOOTER_CLASS) must be last with primary actions (AppButton size=sm, justify-end); AuxiliaryFooter (DIALOG_AUXILIARY_FOOTER_CLASS) for metadata or wizard navigation (justify-between allowed)",
      "appliesTo": [
        "dialog footers",
        "modal footers",
        "DialogFooter"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.wizard.footer-navigation",
      "title": "Step Wizard Footer Navigation",
      "value": "footer uses STEP_WIZARD_FOOTER_CLASS with Previous (AppButton intent=cancel, disabled on first step, ChevronLeft), center Step X / Y counter, and Next (AppButton intent=secondary, disabled on last step or when canMoveNext is false, ChevronRight); final-step primary submit action (Create, Save, Apply) renders through footerExtra with intent=primary to the left of the counter; do not replace Next with submit on non-final steps",
      "appliesTo": [
        "step wizards",
        "wizard footers",
        "wizard navigation"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.labeled-icon-required",
      "title": "Labeled Button Icon Required",
      "value": "no labeled/text AppButton may ship without a leading Lucide icon (h-3.5 w-3.5) before the visible label — modal footer Cancel/Save/Create/Publish rows, form action rows, toolbar labeled actions, and wizard footer actions are invalid when text-only; pick an icon that matches action semantics (X cancel, Plus create, UploadCloud publish/republish, Trash2 delete, Check save/confirm, etc.); exceptions: icon-only buttons (size icon-sm or icon-md with no visible label) and AppButton closeIcon",
      "appliesTo": [
        "labeled action buttons",
        "modal footer buttons",
        "form action buttons",
        "toolbar labeled buttons",
        "wizard footer buttons"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.semantic-intents",
      "title": "Labeled Button Semantic Color Intents",
      "value": "all labeled/text buttons must use AppButton or buttonSemantics intents: primary/create=solid indigo; cancel=slate outline; destructive=solid rose; destructive-soft=rose outline; confirm=emerald outline; secondary=indigo outline; utility=cyan outline; warning=amber outline; toggle-on=cyan soft; toggle-off=indigo soft (pressed tools only); include/exclude wrap chips use AppSelectionToggle (confirm+Check / cancel+X), never toggle-on/off; modal close icons use AppButton closeIcon",
      "appliesTo": [
        "toolbar buttons",
        "modal footer buttons",
        "form action buttons",
        "labeled action buttons"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.icon-action.ghost-only",
      "title": "Ghost Icon Action Buttons",
      "value": "for non-grid icon action buttons (floating row actions, inline input actions, compact tool controls), use ghost icon-only buttons with no border or filled background at rest; reuse ICON_ACTION_*_CLASS from src/shared/ui/surfaceClasses.ts",
      "appliesTo": [
        "floating row actions",
        "inline input actions",
        "compact tool controls",
        "rename input actions"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.icon-action.semantic-colors",
      "title": "Icon Action Semantic Colors",
      "value": "confirm/save-positive uses emerald; cancel/close uses slate; inline delete/remove is icon-only Trash2 with ICON_ACTION_BUTTON_BASE_CLASS + ICON_ACTION_DELETE_CLASS (slate at rest, rose on hover) — not destructive-soft; edit and duplicate use slate at rest and indigo on hover; view/preview/test uses slate at rest and cyan on hover; labeled toolbar/modal delete keeps destructive-soft or destructive intent per ui-dialog.md; inline rename confirm/cancel must be icon-only with confirm/cancel semantics",
      "appliesTo": [
        "icon action buttons",
        "floating actions",
        "inline rename actions",
        "compact destructive controls",
        "list row remove buttons",
        "CrudSetColumnList"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.icon-only.square",
      "title": "Icon-Only Button Square Shape",
      "value": "icon-only buttons (no visible text label) must be square with equal width and height; use AppButton size icon-sm (h-7 w-7) in compact toolbars or icon-md (h-8 w-8) in page/sidebar tool rows; do not use horizontal padding or unequal dimensions that make icon controls rectangular",
      "appliesTo": [
        "icon-only buttons",
        "sidebar tool controls",
        "compact toolbar icon buttons"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.new-plus-icon.secondary",
      "title": "New/Create Icon-Only Plus Button Color",
      "value": "New/Create icon-only Plus buttons must use AppButton with intent secondary (soft indigo outline: border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100); reference DesignerPaletteSidebar.tsx and FunctionListSidebar.tsx; labeled Create buttons with visible text keep intent create (solid indigo)",
      "appliesTo": [
        "new/create icon-only plus buttons",
        "sidebar new actions",
        "palette new actions"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.split-button.standard",
      "title": "Split Button Standard",
      "value": "all split/dropdown toolbar buttons must use AppSplitButton (src/shared/ui/AppSplitButton.tsx); reference Live Designer toolbar / AppSplitButton samples; modes: dropdown-only (unified trigger) or primary+menu (default action + chevron); sizes: compact h-7 for Component Designer toolbars, sm h-8 for page toolbars; use semantic intent (utility, create, etc.); menu panel/items via SPLIT_BUTTON_MENU_PANEL_CLASS and SplitButtonMenuItem; compound controls with secondary non-menu action use SPLIT_BUTTON_COMPOUND_CONTAINER_CLASS with internal border-l divider",
      "appliesTo": [
        "split buttons",
        "dropdown toolbar buttons",
        "primary+menu create buttons",
        "compound toolbar controls"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    }
  ],
  "matchCount": 48,
  "truncated": true,
  "maxRules": 20,
  "knowledgeKinds": [
    "STANDARD",
    "ANTI_PATTERN"
  ],
  "agentsMdPointer": "See AGENTS.md hub and docs/standards/INDEX.md for topic shards.",
  "runtimeApi": "/api/project-standards",
  "shardHint": "Pass shard (e.g. ui-grid) to load the full markdown topic file."
}
